thread:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: multi-GPU collective errors on cluster-gpu-usw2-12, symptom=allreduces stuck, kafka of model-serving pipelines degraded. Auto-escalate to SRE oncall.

Devon Park: I'm on it — seeing alert spikes for 503s on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Which jobs are hitting that node?

Ava Martinez: TP jobs from resnet50-xlarge and a couple of customer TP4 worlds. Traffic routing shows ~60% of inferences queued to that rack.

Marcus Li: quick check: dmesg on node-12 shows multiple Xid 32/79 messages and a repeated nv_peer_mem complaint. Likely GPU driver/oom or NVLink flakiness.

SRE-Bot: sample dmesg snippet attached.

Marcus Li: ```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, PID 5678, GPU 0
[ 1234.568001] audit: type=1701 audit(...): auid=1000
[ 1234.570000] nv_peer_mem: failed to register DMA region: -22
```

Devon Park: thanks. Are the processes still hung or restarting?

Ava Martinez: Runtime shows communicator state stuck on NCCL_COLL_ALLREDUCE at step 1024, tasks reporting 'ncclNetRecv timeout' inside the log. No crash of the launcher yet, but latencies are climbing.

Sana Gupta: I see GPU mem usage pegged at 100% across GPUs for those TP4 worlds. Microbatch size might be too high after recent model change.

Leo Turner: Customer impact: two paid customers in us-west-2 reported elevated tail latency and a few 5xx errors in the last 12 minutes. CS notified them we're investigating and will reroute traffic.

Devon Park: mitigation plan: 1) try soft failover of traffic off node-12 using smart routing, 2) if continued hangs, drain node and kill affected containers, 3) enable NCCL async error handling to get faster failures, 4) if it's driver-level, escalate to infra for node reboot.

Marcus Li: I'll attempt a targeted container restart on the least critical TP jobs first. Before that, bump NCCL debug to INFO to gather more logs: set NCCL_DEBUG=INFO and NCCL_DEBUG_SUBSYS=NET.

Devon Park: commands I used to drain traffic for a service route: 
```
# move live model route away from node-12
redwoodctl routing set-weight --route model-resnet50 --node node-12 --weight 0
# check active requests
redwoodctl jobs list --node node-12 --state running
```

Ava Martinez: Doing a graceful container restart on task 8243 (TP4 world) now. Will monitor KV-cache warmup.

Marcus Li: container restart log: 
```
2026-03-15T10:24:21Z restart: stopping container 8243
2026-03-15T10:24:24Z start: container 8243 started
NCCL WARN: Failed to connect to peer 10.0.3.21: No route to host
```

Sana Gupta: after restart, one world recovered to running but another world still blocked during allreduce. Possibly asymmetric failure — one GPU link flapped.

Devon Park: if link flaps persist, we should cordon the whole host and let Dedicated autoscaler replace the node. Marcus, can you check NVLink status and perfmon?

Marcus Li: NVLink health shows peer link 2 transient errors. Scheduling a node reboot window but want to keep customer impact minimized. Requesting permission to cordon and reimage if reboots don't clear it.

Leo Turner: CS update: customers accepted a limited roll to single-GPU fallback while we remediate. They prefer lower latency predictability over occasional 5xxs.

Ava Martinez: We have a quick runtime-level fallback: switch model routing to the single-GPU quantized variant we prepared last quarter. Doing that now for impacted routes. Should reduce memory pressure and avoid collective ops.

SRE-Bot: routing change applied: resnet50-large -> resnet50-quant-sg for tenant-42 and tenant-77.

Marcus Li: Rebooting node at 10:40 UTC as planned. Kernel logs will be captured and uploaded. If reboot fails to clear Xid, we escalate to driver downgrade/upgrade with infra.

Devon Park: Also enabling NCCL environment flags on the runtime pool so future hangs surface faster: NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1, NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1 (disable IB to test), NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=NVL. We'll roll these to a small canary first.

Sana Gupta: note for ML team: reduce microbatch by 2 for TP4 training-like inference paths. We'll prepare a hotfix config and push as an autoscaling policy adjustment.

Marcus Li: Node reboot done. Post-reboot: no Xid seen so far, GPU temps normal. NVLink errors gone on the first pass. Monitoring for 20m.

Devon Park: long-term action items captured:
- run NVLink stress tests on node-12 hardware pool during next maintenance window
- add alert to detect sustained NCCL net timeouts earlier
- expand fallback model-variants coverage for TP workloads
- update runbook with quick commands to shift routes and enable NCCL async handling

Leo Turner: CS to send consolidated customer note summarizing outage window (10:14-10:42 UTC), mitigation steps, and compensation if needed.

Ava Martinez: closing out command list, leaving a short postmortem in #postmortems once root cause confirmed. For now marking incident as mitigated; continuing to monitor. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident resolved state set to mitigated by Devon Park at 3543211511
